stemMarkdown: The average of 10 observations was calculated as 51, but one observation was wrongly read as 60 instead of the correct value 80. What is the correct average? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The recorded total was $10 \times 51 = 510$. Correcting the single entry changes it by $80 - 60 = 20$, giving a true total of $530$. The correct average is $\dfrac{530}{10} = 53.0$.
